article.title: Delegation by Central Government of its powers and functions.
article.content:
(1) The Central Government may, by notification, and subject to such conditions, limitations and restrictions as may be specified therein, delegate any of its powers or functions under this Act other than the power to make rules to such authority or officer as may be specified in the notification: 1* * * * *
(2) A copy of every notification issued under sub-section (1) shall, as soon as may be after it is issued, be laid before each House of Parliament.
article.html:
458Delegation by Central Government of its powers and functions.

Section 458 · Chapter XXIX · page 247 of the Act

(1) The Central Government may, by notification, and subject to such conditions, limitations and restrictions as may be specified therein, delegate any of its powers or functions under this Act other than the power to make rules to such authority or officer as may be specified in the notification: 1* * * * *

(2) A copy of every notification issued under sub-section (1) shall, as soon as may be after it is issued, be laid before each House of Parliament.

1 The proviso omitted by Act 1 of 2018, s. 93 (w.e.f. 9-2-2018).
